summary: First iteration testing of ClarifyMed. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering health, validation (bad content type/404/empty chat/unknown analysis chat), full upload+polling of /app/tests/sample_lab_report.pdf (completes in ~40s), report shape (12 lab values, 3+ findings, questions/next steps/red flags), list, PDF file download, and SSE chat streaming with persistence. Frontend: Home renders ClarifyMed branding, dropzone, context textarea, analyse button, disclaimer pill, medical disclaimer, and recent reports list. End-to-end upload with sample PDF navigated to /report/{id}, showed analysing-state, then rendered headline, summary-card, 4 finding cards, 12 lab rows with status badges, doctor questions, and next steps. Chat: typing+send flow streams a grounded ~850 char answer; suggestion chips appear on fresh chat; messages persist across reload. Recent reports show completed analyses and clicking navigates to results. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_analysis reads the entire file into memory (up to 20MB) and passes the bytes to a BackgroundTask, holding them for ~40-60s per request. Consider streaming to a temp file and passing the path.
storage.py init_storage isn't concurrency-safe (module-level _storage_key mutated without a lock); acceptable now but worth noting for scale.

ai.analyse_document trusts LLM JSON — if a call returns non-JSON, _parse_json raises and the analysis is marked failed with only the exception string. A user-friendly error message on the report would be nicer.
server.py chat handler builds a new session_id per call so LLM has no server-side memory; conversation history is manually stitched from the last 10 messages, which will lose context for long chats.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 new TEST_ analyses via API/UI (both completed and left in DB); left prior existing analysis be476243-... untouched. TEST_ chat messages added to be476243-... and to the two new analyses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints and full upload+SSE chat flow verified. Fixture at /app/tests/sample_lab_report.pdf takes ~40s to analyse via gemini-3.1-pro-preview. File input <input type=file> is hidden by design, use state="attached" (not visible) when using Playwright. Existing completed analysis be476243-4c51-40a4-bc9e-9b43b9bfd261 is useful for quick UI checks. Chat suggestion chips (chat-suggestion-0..2) only render when there are no messages yet.
